summary: st-test no longer SIGTERMs another seat's live run when it finds it in a pool tree that is free by its lock. Clearing a tree's orphans now: leaves the tree, signalling nothing, when a live st-test or one of its descendants is in it; logs each process it signals, with its command and cwd; runs only when the waiter actually takes the tree, not on every pass that gives a free tree back while it waits for a build slot; and the pool cap never evicts a tree a live st-test is in. A safety fix: two seats' runs died with exit 143 while waiting for a tree on 2026-11-04, cause unconfirmed; should this path ever signal, the log now names each process.

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: scripts/st-test only: a tree a live st-test is in is skipped (logged once per waiter) instead of cleared, so a waiter takes another tree or keeps waiting. Genuine orphans, whose st-test is gone, and this run's own children are cleared as before, now named in the log.
